description: This file defines the Dashboard model for Apache Superset, including its database schema, relationships, methods for exporting, URL generation, and thumbnail updates. It also includes event listeners for dashboard creation and updates, and functions for retrieving dashboards by ID or slug.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: Represents a dashboard in Superset with properties, relationships, and methods for exporting, URL generation, and thumbnail management.

methods.name: copy_dashboard
methods.description: Copies a dashboard template to a new user dashboard upon creation.

methods.name: is_uuid
methods.description: Checks if a value is a valid UUID.

methods.name: is_int
methods.description: Checks if a value can be converted to an integer.

methods.name: id_or_slug_filter
methods.description: Returns a SQLAlchemy filter expression based on whether the input is an ID, UUID, or slug.
